severe_errors.description: Voice, music, sound, font or graphic lacks usable rights.
A key name, term or meaning-changing phrase is pronounced incorrectly.
Actual voice timing is not conformed into the canonical Timeline.
Music or sound effects materially mask narration or dialogue.
Output violates the approved platform loudness or True Peak profile.
Subtitle timing materially differs from the spoken line.
Subtitle or graphic blocks a key face, action, evidence or platform safe area.
